title: Second regression: Michael lying opposite with small being between them
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: whereas in regression number two I found out that Michael was laying opposite to me and there was one of the short ones or small ones between us

plain: In 1977, aboard a craft near a South Dakota nuclear missile site called November 5, a guard named Mario Woods says he lay across from his fellow guard Michael Johnson with a small being standing between them. Woods says he learned this in his second session of regression, a kind of hypnosis meant to bring back lost memories, led by the hypnotherapist Yvonne Smith. It is part of his account of being taken by beings while guarding nuclear weapons.
